title: No Weekend Closings: Home Purchase Agreement Closing Dates Falling on a Saturday or Sunday
content:
**Closing coordination bulletin.** A Home Purchase Agreement closing is never set on a weekend; a closing extension's day reached moves to the nearest weekday:

| Day reached falls on | New closing date |
|---|---|
| Saturday | The Friday before it |
| Sunday | The Monday after it |
| Monday through Friday | The day reached, not moved |

**Hypothetical calendar (June 2026).**

- Day reached Saturday 13 June 2026: the new closing date is Friday 12 June 2026.
- Day reached Sunday 14 June 2026: the new closing date is Monday 15 June 2026.
- Day reached Friday 12 June 2026: the new closing date stays Friday 12 June 2026.

**Notes.**

1. The move is one day back for a Saturday and one day forward for a Sunday, so the closing never lands on a weekend.
2. Weekdays are judged by the calendar day; Calloway holidays are not part of this rule.
